prepare and add fruit.name: retrieve ingredients and tools
prepare and add fruit.definition: Take bowl, plate, knife, spoon, banana, and nuts from cupboards, counter, or fridge.

prepare and add fruit.name: prepare weighing scale
prepare and add fruit.definition: Turn on and zero the scale to prepare for measurements.

prepare and add fruit.name: peel and cut banana
prepare and add fruit.definition: Peel the banana skin, cut the ends off, and slice the banana.

prepare and add fruit.name: add fruit and nuts
prepare and add fruit.definition: Transfer sliced banana and pour raisins or nuts into the porridge.

prepare and add fruit.name: wash and clean up
prepare and add fruit.definition: Rinse hands and tools under the tap, dry them, and put away packages.

microwave porridge.name: retrieve and clear path
microwave porridge.definition: Pick up the porridge bowl and move obstacles out of the way of the microwave.

microwave porridge.name: load microwave
microwave porridge.definition: Open the microwave door and place the porridge bowl inside.

microwave porridge.name: set timer
microwave porridge.definition: Clear previous timers and press start buttons to set the cooking time.

microwave porridge.name: retrieve from microwave
microwave porridge.definition: Open the microwave door when finished and take out the hot porridge bowl.

microwave porridge.name: stir and clean spoon
microwave porridge.definition: Stir the porridge with a spoon and lick or shake excess porridge off the spoon.

measure and mix oats.name: setup bowl and scale
measure and mix oats.definition: Retrieve the scale and bowl, place the bowl on the scale, and turn it on.

measure and mix oats.name: pour oats into bowl
measure and mix oats.definition: Retrieve oats package and pour oats into the bowl on the scale.

measure and mix oats.name: add water and milk
measure and mix oats.definition: Fill glass with water, pour into porridge, and retrieve and pour milk from the fridge.

measure and mix oats.name: mix porridge ingredients
measure and mix oats.definition: Stir the oats, water, and milk mixture together using a spoon.

measure and mix oats.name: store ingredients away
measure and mix oats.definition: Put milk, oats, and scale back into the fridge and cupboards.
